= Numbers, money and currency libraries

Libraries for working with numbers, money, durations, and currency in
JavaScript.

* https://mathjs.org/[Math.js]
* https://github.com/sindresorhus/pretty-ms[pretty-ms]
* https://github.com/rawify/Fraction.js[Fraction.js]
* https://github.com/EvanHahn/HumanizeDuration.js[HumanizeDuration.js]
* https://github.com/scurker/currency.js[currency.js]
